name: Luxor Sandbox
description: OpenClaw sandbox backend that runs tool execution in remote Luxor Sandbox microVM sessions.

authToken.title: Auth Token
authToken.description: Luxor API token. Prefer the LUXORAI_AUTH_TOKEN / LUXORAI_API_KEY (read first) or TENKI_AUTH_TOKEN / TENKI_API_KEY environment variable over storing it in config.

baseUrl.title: API Base URL
baseUrl.description: Luxor API endpoint override. Defaults to LUXORAI_API_ENDPOINT / LUXORAI_API_URL, then the SDK's TENKI_API_ENDPOINT / TENKI_API_URL environment fallback.

workspaceId.title: Workspace ID
workspaceId.description: Luxor workspace the sessions are created in.

image.title: Base Image
image.description: Base image id for created sandbox sessions. Omit for the Luxor default image.

workspaceRoot.title: Workspace Root
workspaceRoot.description: Absolute path inside the session used for per-scope workspaces.

idleTimeoutMinutes.title: Idle Timeout Minutes
idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Terminate the session after this many idle minutes.

tags.title: Session Tags
tags.description: Extra tags attached to created sessions.
